item.title: Union Budget 2026-27 Boosts Tier II and Tier III Cities with Infrastructure Push
item.description: GUWAHATI: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman’s Budget speech on Sunday, February 1, has offered a significant boost to Tier II and Tier III cities. The Budget places renewed emphasis on infrastructure-led growth beyond metro cities, underscoring a strategic push to strengthen emerging urban centres across India. item.title: Union Budget 2026-27: Lower TCS, Extended Deadlines, Tax Relief for Accident Victims Announced
item.description: GUWAHATI; Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Saturday unveiled a wide-ranging reset of India’s personal tax framework, announcing simpler filing timelines, lower TCS rates, tax-free compensation rules, and a one-time disclosure window for foreign assets as part of the Union Budget. item.title: Union Budget 2026-27: Fiscal Deficit Set at 4.3% of GDP, Centre to Devolve ₹1.4 Lakh Crore to States
item.description: GUWAHATI: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman on Sunday, February 1, pegged India’s fiscal deficit for 2026–27 at 4.3 per cent of GDP, marginally lower than the 4.4 per cent projected for the current financial year.
